items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when I met Wiley [Burton], I met him on April 22nd and was married on May 22nd.

ctx.x: Jesus. That’s just occurred to me, that I’ve done that twice. Came back from Australia, got off the plane, and got married before I got back to New York. Then, when I met Wiley [Burton], I met him on April 22nd and was married on May 22nd. That’s the same thing. Wow. I’ll have to think about that. I’ll really have to think about that.
In the midst of – really, everything’s building up, and you get married to a drummer. Did he work with you?
